v0_2_2.title: Fast photo grids and a round of fixes
v0_2_2.summary: Folders of photos now show their previews in seconds, thumbnails fill in where you are, and large downloads, shared links and device transfers finish instead of stopping partway.

items.fastPreviews: Photo grids load in seconds: each photo's small preview is stored sealed with that photo's own key, so a device shows it without downloading the original. zcrypt still can't see it.
items.thumbsInPlace: Thumbnails fill in where you are, instead of shimmering until you leave the folder and come back.
items.noCustomizeMedia: Photos and videos no longer offer Customize, since the picture is their icon.
items.bigDownloads: Large files download in the desktop and Android apps instead of stopping partway.
items.sharedDownloads: Large shared files download completely instead of failing when the server is busy.
items.transfers: Device-to-device transfers keep going as long as data is moving, instead of stopping after 10 minutes.
items.slowLinks: GitHub and GitLab storage no longer time out on large pieces over a slow connection.
items.ownStorageFirst: Uploads use the storage you connected before the shared storage, and the shared storage limit always applies to it.
items.lockKeys: Locking the vault also clears your private key and Space keys from memory.
items.decoyReauth: Setting a decoy password asks for your real password, and your 2FA code when 2FA is on.
items.signInLinks: A sign-in link from email works only once.
items.pushPrivacy: Alerts no longer tell push services what kind of alert they carry.
items.androidBackup: The Android app's private data stays out of Android backups and phone-to-phone transfers.

page.title: What's
page.lede: Every version of zcrypt, in plain words, written by hand so you don't have to read commit messages.
page.upcomingNote: Not released yet. This is what is lined up for the next version.
page.getLatestBody: Updates are free, and the desktop app can update itself. Grab the newest build for your device.
page.downloadLink: See what's new in this version

v0_2_1.title: Automatic backups, a recovery kit and a mini player
v0_2_1.summary: Desktop folders and phone photos now back up on their own, even with the vault locked. A recovery kit saves you from a forgotten passphrase, music and videos keep playing while you browse, and alerts reach you with zcrypt closed.

items.recoveryKit: Make a recovery kit in Settings, Privacy: a key you keep that unlocks your vault if you forget your passphrase. zcrypt can't read it or use it.
items.folderBackup: The desktop app backs up folders you choose, on its own and with your vault locked, as files change or every night at a time you pick. Nothing is ever deleted from your vault.
items.photoBackup: The Android app backs up your photos and videos in the background, with the app closed, as new ones arrive or every night. Choose Wi-Fi only, mobile data only, or either.
items.desktopTray: Closing the desktop window keeps zcrypt running in the tray or menu bar, and it can start quietly when you log in so backups never wait for you.
items.mediaPlayer: Music and videos keep playing while you browse, in a mini player with picture-in-picture and your keyboard's media keys.
items.androidPip: Videos float in picture-in-picture when you leave the Android app.
items.closedAlerts: Alerts for new sign-ins, Space invites and opened share links reach you even with zcrypt closed. Turn them on in Settings.
items.folderUpload: Upload a whole folder from the browser with the new Upload a folder button or by dropping it on your vault. Its folders are recreated with encrypted names, and uploading it again fills it in instead of making a copy.
items.themeSync: Your theme now belongs to your account and follows you to every device, changing everywhere at once. Turn off Same theme on all my devices to give one device its own look.
items.directTelegram: Web uploads to your own Telegram go straight from your browser to Telegram, and only go through our server when Telegram can't be reached.
items.telegramBlocked: If your network blocks Telegram, the vault tells you and suggests a VPN.
items.webLimits: Uploads and downloads that pass through our server have a per-file and a monthly limit, with a meter in Settings, Storage. Direct uploads and the desktop app have no limit.
items.openDesktop: Files too big for the browser come with an Open the desktop app button. It tries the app first and opens the download page if the app isn't there.
items.desktopStorage: The desktop app picks up storage you connected on the web, so its uploads go straight to your storage without connecting twice.
items.windowsInstall: Windows visitors get a one-command install first on the download page, with a calm note about the SmartScreen prompt.
items.codeSigning: A code signing policy page explains which Windows installers are signed and how.
items.adminPlatforms: Admins see which storage each user connected, can filter by platform, and get a marker for heavy web transfers.
items.themeAccounts: Switching accounts on the same device, for example in the desktop app, no longer keeps or copies the previous account's theme.
items.apexDomain: The site works from both zcrypt.cloud and www.zcrypt.cloud.
items.doubleDrop: A file dropped on the Upload dialog is uploaded once, not twice.
items.dropdowns: Long dropdowns scroll inside the screen and have roomier rows.
items.settingsLinks: Links to a settings tab open the right tab.
items.staySignedIn: You stay signed in across reloads instead of being signed out at random.
items.rightClick: Right-clicking a file shows its menu instead of opening it.
items.downloadCount: Download counts on the site count people, not crawlers.

v0_2_0.title: Notifications, sounds and eight languages
v0_2_0.summary: zcrypt now speaks eight languages all the way through, tells you what is going on with notifications, sounds and plain-language progress, and got a lot of quieter privacy and reliability work underneath.

items.translation: The whole app and the website are now translated into Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Russian, Urdu and Chinese, not just the menus.
items.spacesPages: Spaces moved from pop-up windows to real pages with their own links, and you can drive them from the keyboard.
items.backgroundAdds: Adding files to a Space keeps working in the background while you carry on with something else.
items.avatars: Your profile photo now shows wherever your avatar appears, instead of just an initial.
items.installers: One-line installers for macOS, Linux and Windows that avoid the unverified-app warning, plus a Homebrew tap on the download page.
items.selfHosting: A self-hosting kit: run your own zcrypt server on any Linux box behind a Cloudflare Tunnel.
items.languageSuggestion: The site suggests a language based on your country instead of switching it behind your back.
items.changelogPage: This changelog, with a page for every version, an RSS feed and a What's new dialog in the app.
items.fasterShares: Share links are created faster, especially when you share many files at once.
items.updateNotes: The update dialog now tells you what actually changed instead of a vague promise.
items.searchFixes: Page titles no longer repeat the name twice, and the sitemap now has real dates.
items.spacesFixes: Spaces pages ask you to unlock instead of failing, the file picker no longer crashes, and a Space's sealed name stays readable after a key rotation.
items.sealedSpaceNames: Space names are now sealed on your device, like file names already are.
items.keyPinning: Your device remembers the sharing key it first saw for each person and warns you if it later changes.
items.passphraseMinimum: Passphrases have a sensible minimum length now, with hints in every language.
items.noPlaintextNames: The app never sends a file name or hash in the clear, and the server will refuse an old app that tries, once the server is updated.
items.sealedSendHash: The hash for Send links is sealed too, so even that small clue stays with you.
items.csp: The content security policy is now enforced by default instead of only reporting, which makes injected scripts much harder to run.
items.coarseIps: Sign-in sessions now store only a rough IP address too, and login records no longer keep the email you typed.
items.masterKey: Groundwork for one account master key, so a future version can make passphrase changes painless. It is off by default.
items.oldClients: Very old versions of the app will be told to update before uploading once the server is updated, so they can't write unprotected names.
items.quickSettings: A quick settings panel behind the gear icon: theme, light or dark, language and advanced mode without leaving the page.
items.getApps: A Get the apps button: scan a QR code for the Android app, or download the desktop app for your system in one click.
items.paletteActions: The command palette (Ctrl or Cmd + K) can now do things: upload, new folder, lock the vault, switch theme and more.
items.customThemeModes: Custom themes get a matching light and dark version worked out from your colors, so they stay readable in both.
items.backgrounds: Twelve new background designs for custom themes, all following your accent color.
items.vaultSearch: One bigger search bar on the vault page, with your recent files right in its dropdown.
items.iosSwitch: Every toggle is now an iOS-style switch in your theme color, easy to see when it is off.
items.undoToasts: Deleting or moving files happens straight away with an Undo button, instead of asking you first.
items.vaultPolish: A tidier vault: one slim storage notice, clearer list and grid icons, a storage ring in the sidebar, friendlier empty states, right-click menus and smoother loading.
items.mobileLayout: Phones and tablets get a cleaner layout: the lock is always reachable, filters stick to the top and nothing spills off the screen.
items.toolPages: The Pad, Send and Transfer pages show their steps and closing text again.
items.systemTheme: With the theme set to System, the app now follows your device's light or dark switch straight away.
items.connectionStatus: zcrypt now tells you right away when your internet is down or slow, or when our servers can't be reached, and retries on its own.
items.signInRedesign: Cleaner sign-in and sign-up pages: a simple full-page layout with the form on one side, and a live server status under it.
items.notifications: System notifications on the web, desktop and Android: transfer progress, a photo preview, View and Retry buttons, sign-in and storage-full alerts, and a Send a test button in Settings.
items.sounds: Optional sounds for finished, heads-up and problem moments, with three sound sets and a choice to play them only when zcrypt is in the background.
items.transfersPanel: A new transfers panel that lists failed items first, shrinks to a slim bar on desktop and a small orb on phones, and takes drops both ways: drop files on it to upload, or drag files out of the vault to download.
items.feedbackPage: A public feedback page where anyone can send an idea, a problem or a kind word, with an optional email if you want a reply.
items.accountEmails: Emails about important changes to your account and the occasional announcement, each with a one-click unsubscribe link.
items.plainProgress: Upload and download progress in plain words: a bar that never jumps backwards, a rounded time left, and when something fails, what went wrong and how to fix it.
items.messages: One consistent style for messages: repeats merge into one, errors stay until you close them, hovering pauses them and Escape dismisses them.
items.confirmDialogs: Clearer warnings and confirmations that say how many items are affected, show which ones, ask you to type a word before anything permanent, and open as a bottom sheet on phones.
items.siteLight: A calmer look for the website and sign-in: a soft brand light drifts behind the page, with frosted-glass navigation and buttons.
items.largeVaults: Big vaults unlock and scroll smoothly: the grid no longer flickers and the page no longer goes blank on weaker graphics chips.
items.previewRetry: Previews from a storage platform that can't be reached try twice, then offer Try again instead of spinning forever.
items.downloadPause: Pausing and quickly resuming a download no longer cancels it, and stopping a paused download really stops it.
items.uploadResume: Resumed uploads land back in the right folder, and identical files in one batch no longer trip over each other.
items.protectedLinks: Public links to files inside a password-protected folder open correctly.
items.androidStart: The Android app keeps its local vault in its own folder, which fixes a failure on start-up.
items.folderWatch: Desktop folder sync waits until a file has stopped changing and skips temporary and half-downloaded files.
items.toolsRetry: Pad and Send keep what you typed when you retry, and Transfer no longer says it is done after the connection drops.
items.photoPrep: Picking a lot of photos on a phone keeps showing Preparing until they are ready, instead of going quiet after three seconds.
items.emailSpam: Emails from zcrypt now include a plain-text version, so they stop landing in spam.
items.protectedPreviews: Previews from password-protected folders are never saved to disk, and locking the vault or signing out clears them.
items.desktopHardening: The desktop app checks every link it is opened with, limits what it keeps in the keychain, and wipes the cached passphrase from memory.
items.serverHardening: Tighter server checks across Send, folders, Pad and two-factor sign-in, and a signed-out session stays signed out after a server restart.
items.tokenScrub: Storage platform tokens are scrubbed from every error message, so they never reach a log.
items.dependencyFixes: Security updates across the server, the apps and the website, including fixes for certificate checks and compression libraries.

v0_1_7.title: A tour, a bug button, a tidier vault
v0_1_7.summary: A friendlier first week: a guided tour, a way to tell us when something breaks, redesigned Spaces and a vault that opens faster.

items.tour: A short guided tour shows new people around the vault. You can replay it any time from the account menu.
items.bugReports: Report a bug straight from the account menu, with a screenshot if you like.
items.reviews: Rate zcrypt from inside the app. We read every one, including the grumpy ones.
items.spacesRedesign: Spaces were redesigned, with clearer roles for who can view, edit or manage.
items.languagePicker: A language picker sits next to the theme toggle, with eight languages to choose from.
items.toolsRedesign: Pad, Send and Transfer now match the rest of the site.
items.sendLimits: Anonymous Send links are capped at 50 MB per file and 500 MB per day, and a burn-after-read file is deleted once it has been read.
items.androidUpdate: The Android app checks for updates for real, instead of cheerfully saying you are up to date.
items.accountControls: You can export your account data, delete your account, and see and sign out your signed-in devices.
items.fasterVault: The vault loads in parallel and shows what it remembers while it refreshes, so it feels quicker.
items.healthBanner: A health banner explains what is wrong with a storage connection and what to do about it.
items.updatePill: A small pill tells you when a new desktop version is ready.
items.folderLinks: Folder links are quicker to create.
items.signInSync: Signing in or out in one tab now carries over to your other tabs.
items.resumeUploads: One click resumes an unfinished upload from the same device.
items.realNames: Shared files and folders show their real names instead of placeholders.
items.sendRetry: Send replaces a storage repo that was deleted and retries, and lets a burn-after-read link be read to the end.
items.dragDrop: Dragging files onto a folder works reliably, and an ended session sends you to sign-in instead of a blank page.
items.uploadIntoFolder: Desktop uploads land in the folder you have open.
items.refreshRace: Two tabs refreshing at once no longer log you out.
items.twoFactor: Two-factor authentication is now asked on every kind of login, including magic links and OAuth.
items.transferKey: The key for a Transfer no longer passes through the relay.
items.shareDownloads: Share download counts are counted by the server, so limits can't be skipped.
items.sealedNames: Desktop and Android uploads seal file names and use a keyed content hash.
items.nextPatch: Updated Next.js to patch a remote code execution vulnerability.

v0_1_6.title: A new front door and a real Insights page
v0_1_6.summary: The homepage was rebuilt around the product, Insights got a proper redesign, and the vault gained a pile of small conveniences.

items.newHome: A new homepage that shows the drive first and explains later.
items.insights: Insights was redesigned, with a date range, a headline numbers card and a swipeable layout on phones.
items.quickFilter: A quick filter popover, an undo toast, drop-anywhere uploads, rename in place and a recently viewed list.
items.bulkActions: Move or share many files at once.
items.mobileTabs: A four-tab bar on phones that feels native.
items.sharedCap: Shared storage is capped at 1 GiB per user, so the free tier stays fair.
items.siteDesign: Every marketing page now shares the homepage's look.
items.folderTiles: Folder and document tiles in the vault now have the same layered look as the homepage.
items.fasterMarketing: Marketing pages load without waiting for the sign-in check.
items.heroFlash: The homepage no longer flashes or replays its entrance when it loads.
items.logout: Logging out on the web now properly ends the session.
items.rateLimit: Insights shows honest messages when it is rate limited.
items.macUpdates: Mac updates no longer point at a page that does not exist.
items.refreshToken: The refresh token is no longer kept in the browser's local storage.
items.secretScanning: A secret scanner now checks our code for accidentally committed keys. For now it only warns.

v0_1_5.title: Quieter servers, steadier downloads
v0_1_5.summary: Mostly work you only notice when it is missing: stable download links, safer metadata and a lot of small repairs on phones.

items.stableLinks: One stable download link per platform, always pointing at the newest build.
items.mitCore: The zcrypt core engine is now MIT licensed, like the rest of the project.
items.profile: A profile panel for your name, avatar and password, so you can change your password without a reset email.
items.desktopUpdates: The desktop app can now update itself with signed updates, and Settings has an App updates panel. Installs older than 0.1.5 still have to update by hand once.
items.confirmations: The app asks you to confirm before it changes a plan or removes a vault member.
items.safeArea: Phone screens no longer lose their edges, even with an out-of-date system WebView.
items.mobileLinks: Links that open outside the app work on mobile now.
items.updaterLies: The desktop updater stops offering updates it can't install for .deb and .rpm users.
items.downloadVersion: The download page stops showing a stale version when GitHub is slow.
items.phoneDetect: The download page no longer mistakes phones for desktops, and shows Linux packages.
items.emptyLanding: The landing page stopped rendering as empty voids.
items.sealedMetadata: Details that used to reach the server in the clear are now sealed on your device.
items.noPlainNames: The server stops storing plaintext file names, and audit, Pad and Send records keep only a rough IP address.
items.auditRetention: Old audit log entries are cleared automatically after a while.
items.patches: Patched versions of the Go runtime, Tauri and several libraries.

v0_1_4.title: Spaces, folder links and a new desktop engine
v0_1_4.summary: This was a much bigger release than it first looked: end-to-end Spaces, shareable folders, resumable transfers, themes and a rebuilt desktop app, plus the cancel button.

items.spaces: Spaces (shared vaults) got real end-to-end keys: every member has their own key, you can add files and folders, set a size limit, compare key fingerprints and re-key when someone is removed.
items.folderShare: Share a whole folder with a public link, and download it as one zip.
items.resumeTransfers: Unfinished uploads survive a page reload and can be resumed or discarded, downloads can pause and resume, and a single file can be up to 10 GB.
items.insightsPage: A dedicated Insights page for how you use your storage.
items.themes: Per-device colour themes, a custom theme with your own accent and background, and your own icon and colour for files and folders.
items.mediaPlayer: A reworked audio and video player that recognises many more formats and moves on to the next track by itself.
items.mobileVault: The vault was reworked for phones, with a better file grid and drag-to-select.
items.desktopEngine: The desktop app now runs on a new built-in engine instead of a separate helper program, with Touch ID unlock on Mac and auto-lock after a while of inactivity.
items.androidBeta: The first Android build, as a beta APK you install yourself.
items.telegramConnect: Connecting Telegram is guided now, and it finds your chat ID by itself.
items.cancelTransfers: The Cancel button in the desktop app now really cancels a running upload or download.
items.repoRotation: When a storage repository fills up, the desktop app moves on to a fresh one by itself.
items.fasterDownloads: Downloads are decrypted in background workers and large files stream straight to disk.
items.sseBackoff: Live updates reconnect with growing pauses instead of hammering the server.
items.themeFlip: Switching theme no longer plays a heavy transition.
items.emailLinks: Emails link to the right address.
items.fileNames: New uploads have their file names encrypted on your device, and the content hash is keyed per user.
items.twoFactorHardening: Two-factor sign-in got stricter checks, backup codes, and its secrets are now encrypted at rest.
items.auditLog: Admin actions go into a tamper-evident audit log, and destructive ones ask for extra confirmation.
items.cspReportOnly: A content security policy was added in report-only mode, so it watched for problems without blocking anything yet.
items.goPatch: Updated Go and a text library to clear known vulnerabilities.

v0_1_3.title: Mac signing and a sturdier download page
v0_1_3.summary: A small release for macOS users and for the download page.

items.downloadFallback: The download page falls back to a known release when GitHub can't be reached.
items.macSigned: The Mac build is now ad-hoc signed. That is not Apple's notarization, so macOS may still warn you before opening it.

v0_1_2.title: Desktop polish
v0_1_2.summary: Two small fixes that make the desktop app feel less rough.

items.trayIcon: The tray icon is now a clean single-color icon that fits your menu bar.
items.desktopCors: The desktop app is now allowed to talk to the zcrypt server.

v0_1_1.title: A download page and the first desktop app
v0_1_1.summary: Everything got a page of its own: downloads, a unified explorer and viewers for the files you actually have.

items.desktopApp: The first desktop app, which signs in through your system browser. It was rough, and we said so.
items.downloadPage: A download page that always points at the latest release.
items.explorer: A single explorer with a grid view by default and adjustable density.
items.viewers: Viewers for many file types, including a rebuilt PDF viewer and blurred previews for images while they load.
items.bulkDelete: Bulk delete and a revamped upload queue.
items.transferManager: A transfer manager and per-folder encryption.
items.fasterOpen: Opened files are cached and the next ones are prefetched, so they open faster.
items.gentleSync: Background sync backs off when nothing is happening.
items.wrongPassword: A wrong passphrase now lets you try again instead of leaving a broken file.
items.goPatch: A database driver update patches a published vulnerability.

v0_1_0.title: The first public version
v0_1_0.summary: zcrypt starts: you encrypt your files on your device and keep them wherever you like.

items.upload: Upload and download files, encrypted and compressed on your device before they go anywhere.
items.ownStorage: Connect your own GitHub, GitLab, Hugging Face or Telegram account as storage.
items.sharedVaults: Shared vaults, Send, Pad, Transfer and a dead man's switch.
items.accounts: Accounts with email verification, password reset, two-factor sign-in, magic links and sign-in through outside providers.
items.viewer: A file table with sorting, selection, previews and downloads.
items.adminPlans: An admin panel, plans and pricing.
items.hardening: A first round of security hardening and tests.
